Hadith.85 - It was noted that The Commander of the Faithful (as) would not allow anyone to pour water on him while performing wudu.
When he was asked: "O’ Commander of the Faithful, why do you not let them pour water on you?"
Imam (as) said: "I do not like to share my prayer with anyone”.
He also recited the verse of Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted:
"And whoever expects to meet his Lord (azj), let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord (azj)." (Surah Al Kahf 18:110).
